query: Create a medium office building and save it to /tmp/models
expected_output: Agent asks the user for the climate zone before proceeding. Does not assume a default value or hallucinate one. No tool call is made.

query: Create a small office for climate zone 4A using 90.1-2019, save to /tmp/test
expected_output: Calls generate_example_with_default_construction_set with climate zone formatted as ASHRAE 169-2013-4A exactly. Not 4A, CZ4A, or any other variant.

query: Generate an elementary school geometry for climate zone 5A, save to /tmp/schools
expected_output: First, the agent infers that elementary school is a primary school using get_available_building_types. Then it calls get_ashrae_enumeration_values to determine how to map climate zone 5A to a proper climate zone enumeration. Finally calls generate_example_with_default_construction_set with standard 90.1-2013 as the default. Agent explicitly states to the user that it is defaulting to 90.1-2013 rather than silently applying it.
Returns the list of available building types sourced directly from a tool call. Does not answer from memory or training data.
